english.title: Knowingly concerned in fraudulent evasion of plastic packaging tax
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in relation to plastic packaging components, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPONENT..), were knowingly concerned

(A)_[in]_
(B)_[in the taking of steps with a view to]_

the fraudulent evasion of plastic packaging tax by

(C)_[yourself]_
(D)_[another, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER PERSON..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 77(1) and (3) of the Finance Act 2021.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and/or a fine of £20,000 or (if greater) three times the total of amounts of plastic packaging tax that were, or were intended to be, evaded.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and/or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
For an offence committed before the commencement of paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020, the reference to 12 months is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
